multisig.note: 2-of-3 account: your key, a recovery key you hold (phrase or xpub) and Blockstream's key; 2-of-2 with its server also offered

hw_signer.note: Jade over Bluetooth or QR and Ledger Nano X over Bluetooth sign on-chain transactions

psbt.note: Singlesig watch-only: export unsigned PSBT (QR, file, copy) and import signed (QR, file, paste); not multisig

watch_only.note: Singlesig from xpub/ypub/zpub or descriptors; multisig by username and password; no address lists

passphrase.note: Wallet menu 'Log in with BIP39 passphrase' opens a different wallet from the same phrase; set at login

coin_control.note: Select coins on the amount screen lists UTXOs with filter and sort; the picked coins fund the payment

fee_bump.note: RBF only: Speed up Transaction on unconfirmed RBF sends; the app never uses gdk's can_cpfp

taproot.note: Taproot account creation is commented out; a p2tr account shows only if restore finds BIP86 history

descriptors.note: Singlesig accounts show, copy and QR their output descriptors; watch-only import takes descriptors; multisig none

own_server.note: Settings: Personal Electrum server, a URL per network with TLS option; singlesig only, multisig uses Blockstream's backend

verifies_chain.note: gdk removed SPV in 0.75 and reports spv_verified as disabled; balances and history come from the server unchecked

tor.note: Settings: Connect with Tor starts gdk's built-in Tor client; a SOCKS5 proxy option is also offered

seed_standard.note: New wallets get a 12-word BIP39 phrase on a singlesig BIP84 account; multisig funds also need Blockstream's co-signer

cloud_backup.note: No iCloud or file backup; multisig account names and tx notes sync encrypted to Blockstream's server; phrase is manual

license.note: App is GNU GPL v3; the gdk engine it embeds is BSD-MIT licensed
